svg.text: CVA6 Suite 10: Unaligned Word Load/Store Faults & mtval Diagnostic
Phases 2 & 3: LW from 0x80000401 and SW to 0x80000402 triggering exceptions, mtval capture and vectoring

g.text: Microarchitectural Analysis of Word Alignment Traps:

• Unaligned Word Load (0x80000401): In Cycle 351, load_store_unit.sv asserts data_misaligned=1. The core suppresses retirement and vectors to mtvec (0x800000B0). mtval latches 0x80000401 with 100% precision.
• Unaligned Word Store (0x80000402): In Cycle 423, data_misaligned=1 fires for SW. Commit stage sets ex_valid=1 with cause=6 (ST_ADDR_MISALIGNED). mtval latches 0x80000402.

• Handler & MRET Resumption: The ISR at 0x800000B0 reads mcause and mtval, advances mepc by 4 (to skip the faulting instruction), and executes MRET, successfully resuming program flow without deadlocks.
